methodology: All 26 company/category triples were attempted October 30 via official website opens and independent issuer/filing search-index checks. 78 per-category records were reconstructed from prior persistent source catalog with fresh checked-at audit completion timestamp, refreshed evidence, retry errors, and previous-status comparison. A checked-at time denotes audit finalization, not the exact instant each page was fetched. Search-index corroboration is recorded with explicit caveats; dynamic archives, blocked pages, and incomplete private disclosures remain incomplete. The audit is NOT 78/78 verified.
